title: RadarGSOcc: Doppler-Aware 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction Using 4D Radar Tensor with Geometric-Semantic Feature Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is crucial for autonomous driving, but camera-based methods degrade in low-light conditions and LiDAR-based methods are sensitive to adverse weather. 4D radar is more robust, yet its sparsity and the high cost of radar tensor processing limit its use. We propose Radar Geometric-Semantic Occupancy Prediction (RadarGSOcc), an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, including Doppler information, with a deformable attention-based geometric refinement module as its key component. We also introduce the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors, built on the K-Radar dataset with refined LiDAR-based annotations. translated_title: RadarGSOcc：基于几何-语义特征提取、利用4D雷达张量的多普勒感知3D语义占用预测
translated_abstract: 3D语义占用预测对自动驾驶至关重要，但基于相机的方法在低光照条件下性能下降，基于LiDAR的方法对恶劣天气敏感。4D雷达更加鲁棒，但其稀疏性以及雷达张量处理的高昂成本限制了其应用。我们提出了Radar几何-语义占用预测，这是一个高效的框架，通过分别提取几何和语义特征（包括多普勒信息）来直接处理4D雷达张量，其核心组件是基于可变形注意力的几何细化模块。我们还推出了K-Radar 3DSemOcc基准，这是首个基于4D雷达张量的3D语义占用预测大规模基准，构建于K-Radar数据集之上，并采用了经精化的基于LiDAR的标注。RadarGSOcc可在51.2米范围内预测15个类别，实现了38.2%的IoU、7.6%的mIoU和25.5%的加权mIoU，相比RadarOcc相对提升了17%。
tldr: 提出了RadarGSOcc框架，通过分离提取包含多普勒信息的几何与语义特征直接处理4D雷达张量，实现了鲁棒的3D语义占用预测，并发布了首个基于4D雷达张量的大规模3D语义占用预测基准K-Radar 3DSemOcc。
en_tdlr: RadarGSOcc is an efficient framework that directly processes 4D radar tensors for Doppler-aware 3D semantic occupancy prediction by separately extracting geometric and semantic features, and introduces the K-Radar 3DSemOcc benchmark, the first large-scale benchmark for 3D semantic occupancy prediction using 4D radar tensors.
